LESSON: ULUM AL- QUR’AN • MIRACULUOUS NATURE OF QUR’AN • LANGUAGE OF THE QUR’AN • STYLES OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an, part of Qur’an in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why is the Qur’an considered a miracle? 2. How does the language and style of the Qur’an help in its interpretation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the miraculous nature of the Qur’an as a divine scripture.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman,

   Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding,

   Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding,

   Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate the miraculous nature of the Qur’an as a divine scripture.

   Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/read from available reference materials on the characteristics of a miracle and make notes,

2. discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,

3. research online/read from available reference materials on the language of the Qur’an and make class presentations,

4. identify different styles of the Qur’an in the Arabic text and make notes. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/read from available reference materials on the characteristics of a miracle and make notes,
2. discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,
3. research online/read from available reference materials on the language of the Qur’an and make class presentations,
4. identify different styles of the Qur’an in the Arabic text and make notes. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ulum al- Qur’an • Miraculuous nature of Qur’an • Language of the Qur’an • Styles of the Qur’an together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: The skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced as learners discuss

the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups.

• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital devices is enhanced when learners research online on the

language of the Qur’an.

• Communication and collaboration: the skills of teamwork, speaking and listening are enhanced when learners

discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups and make class presentations.

Values:
• Responsibility is enhanced as learners research online/read from available reference materials on the language of the

Qur’an and make class presentations.

• Respect is enhanced as learners discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Social cohesion as learners discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups.

Link to other subjects:

● Arabic as learners research online on the language of the Qur’an.

● English as learners identify different styles from the Arabic text and make notes.
